description: Traffic Cameras is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. View up-to-the-minute traffic camera images of current road conditions on major routes as well as other key intersections. These cameras are solely for traffic monitoring and not enforcement. Camera footage is not recorded. Cameras can be down for maintenance or in the case of collisions, to protect the identity of those involved. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are monitoring, traffic, camera. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
